Saved uncertainty-chaining-contract-v1.md and uncertainty-chaining-fixtures-v1.json

exchanges use distinct governing laws, explicit admission/selection receipts,
consumed information, rebound conditions and correction from an unaffected base.

meaning. The actual UC02 payload supplies the next E-given-D request.

checks passed (uncertainty-chaining-verification-v1.json). The registered checker
exited 1: 237/238 checks passed; whole architecture contracts failed before later
profile checks. Fresh structural v1 and final v2 reports preserve evidence. These
are document consistency checks, not runtime or independent substantive review.

uncertainty-chaining-structural-check-v1/v2.json and their execution records;
P16 architecture.json, result.md and progress.md. No production/controller/tests
or frozen evidence changed. The verification JSON retains the exact temporary
standard-library diagnostic source and execution manifest.

substantive review of the integrated uncertainty group including the repaired
chains; resolve material findings before accounting/state-transition work.
